name: game-unity
description: Build games in Unity (C#): MonoBehaviour lifecycle, prefabs, physics, scenes, the update loop, profiling. Use for Unity projects and .cs game scripts. Detect Unity before claiming you can build.
checklist: Work off Update where possible (cache, pool objects)
pitfalls: Allocating in the update loop causing GC hitches

name: game-unreal
description: Build games in Unreal Engine (C++/Blueprints): actors, components, gameplay framework, ticking, replication. Use for Unreal projects and .cpp/.h gameplay code.
checklist: Expensive work off Tick; use timers/events
pitfalls: Dangling pointers without UPROPERTY GC tracking

name: game-godot-engine
description: Build games in Godot (GDScript/C#): nodes, scenes, signals, the game loop, physics bodies. Use for Godot projects beyond a single script.

name: threejs
description: Build 3D web scenes with Three.js: scene/camera/renderer, geometries, materials, lights, the render loop, GLTF loading. Use for Three.js/WebGL projects.
pitfalls: GPU memory leaks from undisposed resources
Too many draw calls / unbatched meshes

name: webgl-shaders
description: Write GLSL shaders for WebGL/Three.js: vertex/fragment stages, uniforms, attributes, varyings, precision. Use for custom shaders and visual effects.
checklist: Work moved to vertex stage where possible

name: shader-programming
description: Write shaders across APIs (GLSL/HLSL/WGSL): lighting models, PBR, post-processing, compute. Use for shader authoring beyond WebGL. Detect the toolchain first.
pitfalls: Doing per-pixel work that belongs per-vertex

name: game-loop-patterns
description: Design robust game loops: fixed vs variable timestep, interpolation, decoupling update from render, determinism. Use when building/fixing a game loop.
pitfalls: Spiral of death from unbounded catch-up

name: physics-simulation
description: Simulate physics: rigid bodies, collision detection/response, integration, constraints, stability. Use for game/simulation physics work.

name: procedural-generation
description: Generate content procedurally: noise (Perlin/Simplex), seeds, wave function collapse, L-systems, reproducibility. Use for procgen terrain/levels/textures.

name: sprite-animation
description: Build 2D sprite animation: atlases, frame timing, state machines, skeletal (Spine/DragonBones). Use for 2D game animation.
checklist: Atlas packing to reduce draw calls
Frame timing independent of frame rate
Animation state machine over ad-hoc flags
pitfalls: Texture bleeding from tight atlas packing

name: game-audio
description: Implement game audio: mixing, spatial/3D sound, DSP, latency, middleware (FMOD/Wwise). Use for game sound systems.
pitfalls: Audio thread blocked by game logic

name: game-networking
description: Build multiplayer networking: client prediction, server reconciliation, lag compensation, snapshot interpolation, authority. Use for netcode.
pitfalls: Sending full state instead of deltas

name: webxr-ar-vr
description: Build AR/VR experiences (WebXR/Unity XR): stereo rendering, controllers, comfort, performance budgets. Use for XR projects.

name: web3-ethers
description: Interact with EVM chains from JS/TS (ethers.js/viem/web3.js): providers, signers, contracts, events, gas. Use for dApp frontends/backends.
pitfalls: Assuming tx success without waiting for confirmations
Float math on token amounts (use BigInt)

name: smart-contract-testing
description: Test smart contracts (Foundry/Hardhat): unit, fuzz, invariant, fork tests, gas snapshots. Use for contract test suites.
checklist: Fuzz + invariant tests on critical logic

name: defi-patterns
description: Reason about DeFi mechanisms and their risks: AMMs, lending, oracles, flash loans, MEV. Use for DeFi contract/design review. Defensive/educational only.
checklist: Reentrancy and CEI on external calls

name: nft-metadata
description: Design NFT metadata and storage: ERC-721/1155, tokenURI, IPFS/Arweave, immutability, standards. Use for NFT contracts/collections.
checklist: No mutable centralized metadata unless intended
pitfalls: Metadata on a server that can vanish

name: wallet-integration
description: Integrate wallets (MetaMask/WalletConnect/RainbowKit): connect flow, chain switching, signing, UX. Use for dApp wallet flows.

name: blockchain-indexing
description: Index on-chain data (The Graph/subgraphs/custom indexers): events, reorg handling, queries. Use for reading chain data at scale.

name: arduino
description: Program Arduino/microcontrollers (C++): setup/loop, GPIO, interrupts, timers, serial, memory limits. Use for .ino/embedded C++ on AVR/ESP. Detect the toolchain first.
checklist: ISRs short; volatile for shared vars

name: embedded-c
description: Write firmware in C for MCUs: registers, memory-mapped IO, interrupts, DMA, no-heap patterns, real-time constraints. Use for bare-metal/RTOS C.
pitfalls: Stack overflow from deep calls/large locals

name: rtos-firmware
description: Build on an RTOS (FreeRTOS/Zephyr): tasks, priorities, queues, semaphores, ISR-safe APIs, priority inversion. Use for RTOS firmware.
checklist: ISR-safe API variants used from interrupts

name: mqtt-iot
description: Build IoT messaging with MQTT: topics, QoS, retained/LWT messages, TLS, constrained devices. Use for IoT device/broker comms.

name: raspberry-pi
description: Build on Raspberry Pi / Linux SBCs: GPIO, I2C/SPI, camera, systemd services, headless setup. Use for Pi/SBC projects.
pitfalls: Blocking GPIO polling instead of interrupts

name: mcp-server-dev
description: Build MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers: tools, resources, prompts, transports (stdio/SSE), schemas. Use when creating an MCP server for Claude/agents.
checklist: Errors returned as data, not crashes

name: ai-agent-orchestration
description: Orchestrate multi-step/multi-agent AI systems: planning, tool routing, memory, budgets, evaluation, guardrails. Use for agentic pipelines.
checklist: Untrusted tool output treated as data
pitfalls: No eval of the full task, only steps

name: vector-databases
description: Operate vector databases (Pinecone/Weaviate/Qdrant/pgvector/Milvus): indexes (HNSW/IVF), metadata filters, hybrid search, cost. Use for semantic search/RAG storage.
checklist: Index type/params tuned for recall vs cost
Metadata filtering + hybrid search where useful
pitfalls: Mismatched embedding model index vs query

name: image-generation
description: Use image-generation models/APIs (diffusion): prompts, control (ControlNet/img2img), safety, cost, upscaling. Use for programmatic image gen.
pitfalls: No safety filtering on user prompts

name: speech-processing
description: Build speech features: speech-to-text (Whisper), text-to-speech, diarization, streaming, latency. Use for voice/audio AI.
checklist: Streaming vs batch chosen for latency

name: ocr-extraction
description: Extract text/structure from images and PDFs (Tesseract/vision models): preprocessing, layout, tables, confidence. Use for document/OCR pipelines.

name: function-calling
description: Design LLM tool/function-calling: JSON schemas, validation, error handling, parallel calls, determinism. Use when wiring tools to an LLM.
